Name: JP's Utility Machines - Roe Extractor
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#00ff00][u][center]Roe Extractor[/center][/u][/color][/size][/i][/b]
[color=#00ffff][size=5][b][i]Animal cruelty reaches new limits, throw that fish and wait to get its roe. Or maybe you'll get a well-deserved surprise.[/i][/b][/size][/color]


[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]In Willy's store you will find two machines for sale that will allow you to extract roe from any fish, even legendary ones. The price to pay is that you will lose the fish, so you must consider very well what you will do. [/size][/font]
[/list][size=4]
[/size][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]You can get the roe corresponding to the fish, get generic roe in larger quantities or simply get some garbage that the fish has swallowed.[/size][/font]
[/list]
[color=#ff0000][size=5]That's all, very cruel but that's all. I hope you enjoy it![/size][/color]
